 pth=b/name;d=json.loads(pth.read_text());qs={x['command']:x for x in d['attempts']};query.append((pth,d,qs))

prelog,postlog=pre['BLELOG?'],post['BLELOG?']
assert prelog['fields']['gen']==postlog['fields']['gen']=='1'
for x in [prelog,postlog]:
 assert x['fields']['connected']=='1' and x['fields']['dataActive']=='1' and x['fields']['ordinaryAllowed']=='0'
deltas={key:(int(postlog['fields'][key])-int(prelog['fields'][key]))%(1<<32) for key in ['policyDrop','dropL']}

received=w['BLE']['counts']['ordered_integrity_valid_frames'];missing=w['BLE']['missing_observations']['count'];expected=received+missing;ratio=missing/expected
assert (received,missing,expected)==(7776,29,7805)
limit=criteria['normal_link']['nominal_gap_budget_fraction'];assert ratio<=limit
old_boot=b/'ble-log-policy-01-boot-verification.json';adapter=b/'ble-log-policy-01-boot-verification-02.json'

output=s/'screen-17-criteria-v2-supplement.json';command=b/'screen-17-criteria-v2-supplement-01-command.json';assert not output.exists()
